evidence_summary: Personal site documents Fudan 2017, Microsoft, Vercel 2018, SWR 2019, Next.js core since 2020. SWR at ~25 is a clear material OSS milestone with wide adoption. Birth year ~1994 from personal site signals and CSV; NOI olympiad background supports early technical depth.
starting_point: Born ~1994 in China; Fudan CS with earlier National Olympiad in Informatics participation; Microsoft then Vercel.
current_position: Designer/engineer at Vercel; core Next.js maintainer; co-creator of SWR, Satori, and major contributions to v0 and AI SDK.

Co-created v0 and advanced AI SDK/streaming rendering work at Vercel.
